URL: https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/07/mediators-propose-10-day-ceasefire-revive-iran-us-interim-deal-senior-iranian
NOTE: Reuters (Dubai, 20 Jul), carried via Al-Monitor/Times of Israel. "Mediators have passed Iran a proposal to de-escalate the war with the U.S. that would offer a 10-day ceasefire to find ways to revive an interim deal reached last month, a senior Iranian official told Reuters on Monday." MoU signed last month included 60-day ceasefire, Hormuz reopening, timeframe for final deal on nuclear programme. Reuters original: reuters.com. Cross-ref Times of Israel liveblog (newsroom) and Middle East Eye. Rubio (via NYT/Firstpost): US "open to a diplomatic solution" but Iran must halt attacks to give diplomacy a chance.
